reviews.text:
We ordered a Cuddle Clone after losing our beloved pet, hoping it would bring us some comfort during one of the most painful periods of our lives.
The marketing, communication and build-up created enormous expectations. We were repeatedly led to believe that we would be overwhelmed with joy when we opened the box and that many customers cry happy tears when they see their pet again.
Sadly, our experience was the complete opposite.
When the clone arrived, we were left shocked and heartbroken. Not a single defining feature of our pet had been captured accurately. The eyes, face, ears, expression, proportions and overall appearance looked nothing like the photographs we had supplied. Instead of seeing our beloved companion, we were looking at something we barely recognised.
Perhaps the biggest disappointment was the quality and feel of the product itself. Despite the name "Cuddle Clone", the clone we received was extremely hard and rigid rather than soft, comforting or cuddly. Had we known this beforehand, it would have significantly influenced our purchasing decision.
As grieving pet owners, we poured our hearts into this process, shared countless photographs and trusted the promises being made. The result left us feeling even more upset than before. Not only had we paid a substantial amount for the clone itself, but we were also required to pay customs charges on top.
This was not simply a disappointing purchase. It was an emotional experience that left us feeling let down at a time when we were at our most vulnerable.
We appreciate that every custom product is subjective, but in our case the clone bore so little resemblance to our pet that it was genuinely distressing to open the package.
We would strongly encourage anyone considering this service to carefully manage their expectations and to understand that the final product may look very different from the photographs provided.

I ordered a custom plush clone of my dog Bailey, who had just passed away. The likeness was really disappointing - the facial markings were partially captured but the snout and muzzle looked nothing like her, generic and toy-like rather than a true resemblance.

When I contacted customer service to request a refund, they made three separate attempts to get me to accept less - offering an alteration, then a 50% partial refund - before finally processing the return.

While they did refund the item cost, they refused to refund the delivery charge despite the product not accurately resembling my pet as described. For a memorial item purchased during one of the most difficult times of my life, the whole experience fell short.

Save your money and find a smaller, specialist maker who will take the time to get the likeness right.

Item is of very poor quality, not just in photo but overall material etc.  Threw them out. But maybe worse, is the constant barage of HUNDREDS of emails.  I have asked nicely to be removed and have been assured with no result. What is the point of  emails to someone who does not like your product.  You are not just a bad product, but a pest. Referring to the below answer, if you want better customer relations just remove me from your list.  Got about 10 more emails since writing this review.

I received a product that looked nothing like my dog.  I was extremely disappointed.  I was offered alterations but since the first attempt was so bad and so far away from what my dog looked like, I declined and asked for a refund.  Customer service was fantastic and my refund was processed within minutes of my email requesting it.  Be aware, if you approve alterations, you waive the 100% money back guarantee.  Its too bad the production team doesn't take the time to make a decent replica of your dog but instead just ignores photos and does their own thing.  The dog not only didn't resemble my dog, it didn't even resemble the breed.  Do not recommend buying from this company but very grateful for the customer service I received and getting a full refund.

I paid a rush fee to have my orders produced in two weeks. After two weeks, the company generated USPS shipping labels. However, USPS tracking indicated they had not received the items from the sender for going on two weeks - only the shipping labels had been generated. Cuddle Clones refused to refund the rush fees, claiming just generating the shipping labels meant the orders had entered shipping process. This is a fraudulent way of charging rush fees without actually meeting an accelerated production deadline, and trying to deceive the consumer through producing USPS shipping labels without shipping the product.

Unparalleled customer service. Their responses were prompt as they demonstrated understanding throughout the whole process. We high recommend and will be purchasing from them again in the future.
Easy to reach. Very helpful. Easy to communicate with. Awesome company!

Very professional. They wanted to make sure I'm happy with the outcome of our Cuddle Clone.

Harlow was my very first dog. Losing her to the disease PLE after 11 years was devastating. I saw an ad for cuddle clones, a stuffed toy which would look like Harlow. My husband was hesitant saying you can’t replace Harlow, but having a little stuffed toy that looked exactly like her was just what I needed. The process was easy. I submitted the necessary photos of Harlow. I received emails asking for more photos and more information about the color of her hair and the shape of her ears. Questions like was her tail up or down? Was her tongue in or out. Was her mouth open or shut? Every little detail they asked  me helped to produce an almost identical copy of my Harlow. Of course, I cried when the package came and Harlow’s  two siblings ran over to give the toy a kiss. I am very grateful for a company like this who can bring a little bit of joy to a devastating loss. Thank you so much from the bottom of my heart.

Paid $300 for a stuffed animal that was supposed to be a clone of my deceased cat. Had the 2week rush but the company did not stick to that (from order to delivery was almost a month). 

Also, I was not aware that this product was made in China (they put it together in China, then it has to ship to the US to their HQ, and then it ships again to the customer) and honestly if I had known that I wouldn’t have purchased from this company at all.  

When I did finally receive it, it wasn’t a clone at all… yes the pattern was mostly correct but I wound up with a super expensive stuffed animal that looked “kinda” like my cat.  Fur length was way off, face shape was not right, eyes were not right, neck width was not right, it was overall just too fat, and the zipper on the bottom wasn’t even sewn on straight. It also has a strong chemical smell and the fur feels chalky. 

I sent in photos of the clone and photos of my cat and was given a full refund. They did give me the option to have alterations done but why would I trust them to do that after the process so far? 

I’ve seen photos of a lot of dog clone reviews and those seem to be great (as long as it’s an actual breed - I haven’t seen any of a mixed breed or mutt breed) but they suck at cats… so just do not waste your time.

Here are the most basic details they ignored:

Ernestine was polydactyl — she had six toes on each foot. Completely missed.

She had a permanently flapped ear from a past hematoma injury. This was clearly described and visible in photos. Ignored.

She frequently had her tongue sticking out when relaxed — again, visible in many photos. Ignored.

Her coat color is completely wrong.

What they created looks nothing like my cat. Nothing I sent — photos, descriptions, notes — is reflected in the final product. When you’re trusting a company with something this emotional, this personal, the expectation is care and attention. What I received felt rushed, careless, and frankly insulting.

I emailed them immediately expressing how upset I was and requesting a refund and cancellation. Days later, I still haven’t received a response.

This wasn’t just a bad purchase — it was a heartbreaking experience during a time of grief. I would strongly caution anyone considering this company, especially if you’re ordering a memorial piece for a pet you loved.
